items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I met a few of them, but you see, at that time, when I saw or heard Oliver's band at the Royal Garden, I wasn't playing there, I was just there on a vacation.

ctx.x: What about some of the members of the Oliver band, the Dodds Brothers, Dutrey, did you know any of them?
I met a few of them, but you see, at that time, when I saw or heard Oliver's band at the Royal Garden, I wasn't playing there, I was just there on a vacation.
